description: Design skeleton loading screens: line count, widths, shimmer effect and colors, with a live preview and copyable CSS.

faqs.a: Yes — the snippet is plain CSS (plus a few empty divs). No JavaScript is needed.
Change the line count and line height; the generator also randomizes line widths so the preview looks like real text.
faqs.q: How do I make it look like text lines?

faqs.a: Toggle shimmer off and both layers use the same base color for a calm static placeholder.
faqs.q: Can I make a static skeleton without shimmer?

howto: Set the number of lines, line height and corner radius.
Toggle the shimmer sweep effect and pick base/shimmer colors.
Click "Copy HTML + CSS" to grab the snippet.
